localeSwitcher.disclosure: Ukuhumutjha kungasizwa yi-AI. Ilwazi lethenda lihlala ngelimi lomthombo.

publicChrome.freePilot: Simahla ngesikhathi sokutjhayela · bekube mhlazi-31 kuNobayeni 2026
publicChrome.englishAuthoritative: Ikhasi leli litholakala ngesiNgisi kwaphela. Inguqulo yesiNgisi inegunya.
publicChrome.footerBody: Ilwazi lomphakathi labathengisi, abathengi, abalingani bokuhlola kanye nababambiqhaza bokuthenga. Amakhasi wezomthetho newomthethokambiso anelimi lokubamba indawo begodu akusiso isiyeleliso sokugcina sezomthetho.

home.headline: Lapha abaphakeli be-SA bahlangana nokuthenga kwamambala.
home.intro: Phequlula amathenda womphakathi ahlolwe ngokuzenzakalelako kanye nama-RFQ ngokwebubulo, iphrovinsi kanye nelanga lokuvala—ngeenkhonkco eziya emithonjeni yasekuthomeni.
home.sourceNote: Amathuba womphakathi atholakala emarheni wokuthenga asemthethweni.
home.supplierBody: Thola amathuba. Thola ukuqinisekiswa. Khulisa ibhizinisi lakho.
home.smartScoreBody: Yakhiwe ngokubuyekezwa kobufakazi bokuthobela kanye nokuqinisekiswa kwebhanga.
home.buyerBody: Umthombo wabathengisi abaqinisekisiweko. Thumela ama-RFQ. Phatha iingcaphuno.
home.statsBody: Amathuba wamanje avela kuma-eTender karhulumende asemthethweni, ahlolwa ngokuzenzakalelako malungana nezaziso ezikhanseliweko nofana esele zinikelwe.
home.network: Inethiwekhi yokuthenga iSewula Afrika kade ilindele.
home.supplierPoint1: Tlola ibhizinisi lakho. Layisha inomboro yakho ye-CSD nesitifiketi se-B-BBEE.
home.supplierPoint2: Thola i-SmartScore—isilinganiso sakho sokuthemba, esibonakala kiwo woke umthengi.
home.supplierPoint3: Ama-RFQ ahambelanako aza kuwe. Akusekho amalanga wokuvala aphuthelwe.
home.verified48: Kuqinisekiswe emahoreni ama-48. Alikho ikhadi lekhredithi.
home.smartScoreIntro: Umthengisi ngamunye uphethe i-SmartScore—ehlolwe ngokujamelana nemithombo emine esemthethweni ye-SA, ebuyekezwe lithimba lethu.
home.smartScoreRank: Thola ama-90 nofana ngaphezulu begodu iphrofayili yakho ihlala phambili ekufuneni kwabathengi.
home.buyerPoint1: Thumela i-RFQ ngemizuzu emihlanu. Setha isidingo sakho se-B-BBEE, iphrovinsi, kanye nebanga lenani.
home.buyerPoint3: Madanisa iingcaphuno eceleni—ngayinye ine-SmartScore nebheji yokuqinisekisa.
home.trustOfficialBody: I-CSD, i-SARS, i-CIPC kanye nobufakazi bebhanga—bubuyekezwe lithimba lethu ngaphambi kobana kuvele umthengisi.
home.trustMatchingBody: Amathuba avulekileko afaniswa namaphrofayili wabathengisi ngamabubulo atlolisiweko nephrovinsi.
home.trustNotificationsBody: Abathengisi bayayeleliswa kungakapheli imizuzu embalwa ngemva kokuthi i-RFQ efanako ithunyelwe.
home.trustAuditBody: Ikhowuthi ngayinye, umvuzo, nokuthengiselana kulotjhwe begodu kuthunyelwe ngaphandle ukuze kuhlolwe ukuthenga.

opportunities.ctaBody: Hlanganyela neenkulungwana zabathengisi beSewula Afrika abaqinisekisweko—thumela iingcaphuno, ufumane amathuba, begodu ukhulise ibhizinisi lakho ku-AiForm Procure.
opportunities.screenedHelp: Irhelo leli lidlule ekuhlolweni okuzenzakalelayo kwezaziso ezikhanseliweko nofana esele zinikelwe—qala i-Trust Center ukuthola amathuba asebenzako.
